# Oracle Documentation

> > Comprehensive technical documentation for Oracle Database, Java SE, and enterprise software products.

Oracle's official documentation portal provides in-depth guides, reference materials, and best practices for database administrators, Java developers, and enterprise architects. Coverage spans Oracle Database schema objects and performance optimization, Java SE deployment and configuration, and related Oracle technologies.

## Key Topics

- Oracle Database
- B-Tree Indexes
- Bitmap Index
- Function-Based Index
- Index-Organized Table
- Java Control Panel
- Java SE (JDK 9)
- JavaFX
- Java Web Start
- Database Performance
- Schema Objects
- Browser-Embedded Applications
- Java Runtime Environment
- Certificate Management
- Application Domain Index

## Database Indexes and Performance

- [Indexes and Index-Organized Tables](https://docs.oracle.com/database/121/CNCPT/indexiot.htm): Oracle Database guide on B-Tree, Bitmap, and Function-Based indexes

## Java SE Deployment and Configuration

- [Java Control Panel](https://docs.oracle.com/javase/9/deploy/java-control-panel.htm): JDK 9 guide for configuring Java/JavaFX browser-embedded applications
